events.text: George Ared White was born in Saline County, Illinois.
events.subject: self
events.quote: George Ared White was born on July 18 , 1880 , in Saline County , Illinois .

events.text: He enlisted in the Utah National Guard as a musician.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On August 1 , 1895 , he enlisted in the Utah National Guard as a musician .

events.text: He was discharged in order to enlist in the U.S. Volunteers for the Spanish–American War.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was discharged in June 1898 in order to enlist in the U.S . Volunteers for the Spanish–American War .

events.text: He remained in Federal service until discharged.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He remained in Federal service until discharged in December 1898 .

events.text: White re-enlisted in the Guard.
events.subject: self
events.quote: White re-enlisted in the Guard in 1899

events.text: He was discharged.
events.subject: self
events.quote: before being discharged in 1903

events.text: He moved to Oregon.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He moved to Oregon , where he enlisted in the 3d Infantry , Oregon

events.text: He was promoted to first lieutenant.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The next day he was promoted to first lieutenant .

events.text: White was promoted to Captain.
events.subject: self
events.quote: White was promoted to Captain on March 21 , 1911 .

events.text: White was appointed Adjutant General of Oregon.
events.subject: self
events.quote: White was appointed Adjutant General of Oregon on February 1 , 1915 .

events.text: White obtained a leave of absence in order to command a troop of Oregon cavalry.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he obtained a leave of absence in order to command a troop of Oregon cavalry

events.text: White's service on the Mexican border began.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After service on the Mexican border from June 1916 to February 1917

events.text: White's service on the Mexican border ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After service on the Mexican border from June 1916 to February 1917

events.text: White resumed his post in Oregon.
events.subject: self
events.quote: White resumed his post in Oregon .

events.text: The National Guard was mobilized.
events.subject: other
events.quote: On March 23 , 1917 , the National Guard was mobilized .

events.text: White re-entered federal service with the rank of major and was assigned as Assistant Adjutant General of the 41st Division.
events.subject: self
events.object: Assistant Adjutant General of the 41st Division
events.quote: He re-entered federal service on September 10 , 1917 , with the rank of major and assigned as Assistant Adjutant General of the 41st Division

events.text: White served in France.
events.subject: self
events.quote: White served in France from January 1918 to June 1919 .

events.text: White's service in France ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: White served in France from January 1918 to June 1919 .

events.text: White was promoted to lieutenant colonel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was promoted to lieutenant colonel on November 13 , 1918 .

events.text: White was separated from Federal service.
events.subject: self
events.quote: White was separated from Federal service on July 23 , 1919

events.text: White resumed his duties as Adjutant General.
events.subject: self
events.quote: resumed his duties as Adjutant General on April 15 , 1920

events.text: White was promoted to colonel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he was promoted to colonel on June 23 , 1920

events.text: White assumed command of the 82nd Infantry Brigade.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He assumed command of the 82nd Infantry Brigade , a brigade composed of Oregon troops , the same day

events.text: White attended the Command and General Staff School.
events.subject: self
events.quote: White attended the Command and General Staff School from 1925 to 1926

events.text: White's attendance at the Command and General Staff School ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: White attended the Command and General Staff School from 1925 to 1926

events.text: White took part in training seminars organized by the War College.
events.subject: self
events.quote: took part in training seminars organized by the War College in 1928

events.text: White was promoted to major general.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On January 3 , 1930 , he was promoted to major general

events.text: White was appointed to command the 41st Division.
events.subject: self
events.quote: appointed to command the 41st Division

events.text: The 41st Division was inducted into Federal service for one year.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: on September 16 , 1940 , with President Franklin D . Roosevelts signing of the Selective Training and Service Act of 1940 , the 41st Division was inducted into Federal service for one year

events.text: Selective service men began to arrive.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: Selective service men began to arrive in February 1941

events.text: The 41st Division moved to the Hunter Liggett Military Reservation.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In May 1941 , 41st Division moved to the Hunter Liggett Military Reservation

events.text: White was one of 20 officers at the Allied Officers Club credited with the founding of The American Legion.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on February 16 , 1919 , who were credited with the founding of The American Legion

events.text: White was awarded the French Grand Cross of the Legion of Honor.
events.subject: self
events.object: French Grand Cross of the Legion of Honor
events.quote: he was awarded the French Grand Cross of the Legion of Honor on July 9 , 1934

events.text: White died at his home in Clackamas, Oregon.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He died at his home in Clackamas , Oregon , on November 23 , 1941 .

events.text: Camp White was named after him.

events.quote: Camp White was named after him in 1942
